query:
SELECT "clientId" AS client_id, SUM(upload)::bigint AS upload,
                  SUM(download)::bigint AS download
           FROM "TrafficLog" WHERE "nodeId" = $1 AND "recordAt" >= $2
             AND ($3::text IS NULL OR "clientId" IN
                  (SELECT id FROM "Client" WHERE "resellerId" = $3))
           GROUP BY "clientId"
